measured.vlm_formula: sum(n_leads * latency_seconds_mean) over all rows of the three canonical per-seed aggregate reports

assumptions.personnel: Illustrative loaded institutional hourly costs and assumed hours, unchanged from the prior estimate. They are not official salaries or recorded timesheets.

hardware_reported_by_author.vlm: A borrowed self-managed cluster with two NVIDIA A100 GPUs, supplied by the supervisor
hardware_reported_by_author.cnn: The author's own NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 PC
hardware_reported_by_author.a100_memory_and_form_factor: Not confirmed, the valuation uses an explicit reference scenario rather than claiming a known configuration

cluster_depreciation.interpretation: An imputed economic cost for access to the borrowed equipment. No hardware purchase or rental payment is claimed.

cluster_electricity.interpretation: Conservative engineering estimate based on maximum GPU TDP plus host load and cooling, not metered energy.

assumptions.time_limit: Canonical request latency and training counters do not measure reserved-node wall time, GPU occupation or energy. The 20 node-hours and 10 PC-hours remain explicit allowances, not measured durations.
assumptions.workstation: EUR 1200 / 48 months * 6 months = EUR 150. This allocation includes the existing RTX 3060 workstation, so no additional RTX depreciation is charged in compute.
assumptions.electricity_tariff: EUR 0.25/kWh is an assumed calculation rate, not the university or author's actual tariff. Eurostat provides market context rather than a price quote for this equipment.
assumptions.clinical_data: Existing supplied retrospective research data, no new acquisition or prospective validation budget.
assumptions.excluded: New recruitment, new clinical labeling, prospective or multicentre validation, production deployment, foundation-model pretraining, institutional overhead allocation and additional indirect taxes.

sources.supports: A100 TDP of 250 W for 40 GB PCIe, 300 W for 80 GB PCIe and 400 W for SXM variants.

sources.supports: Published retailer search listing for a refurbished 80 GB A100. Used only as replacement-cost context. The product page itself returned HTTP 403 during retrieval. It is not the acquisition price of the borrowed cards.

sources.title: Eurostat electricity price statistics
sources.supports: EU household average EUR 0.2832/kWh in H1 2026 provides order-of-magnitude context. The calculation uses a separate rounded EUR 0.25/kWh assumption.
